verses.english: “These two, mendicants, are not startled by a crack of thunder.

verses.pali: Bhikkhu ca khīṇāsavo, sīho ca migarājā.
verses.english: A mendicant who has ended defilements; and a lion, king of beasts.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve asaniyā phalantiyā na santasantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two who are not startled by a crack of thunder.”
